requirements.quote: The TP/the member of Consortium should be a company registered in India having its office in India and incorporated under the Indian Companies Act, 1956/2013 and should be at least five years (from the date of releasing this RFP) old company.
requirements.text: The bidder must be a company registered in India under the Indian Companies Act, 1956/2013, and at least five years old.
The bidder must provide a copy of their PAN card.
The bidder must provide a copy of their GST registration.

requirements.quote: Proof of Consortium should be submitted (Consortium agreement as per Annexure-XII)
requirements.text: The bidder must submit proof of consortium agreement as per Annexure-XII.

requirements.quote: Consortium can be formed between Categories (for example: Smart Meter Manufacturers with HES Solution Providers/ HES Solution Providers with MDMS Solution Providers). In case of Consortium, the number of bidders including Lead Bidder can be maximum two.
requirements.text: Consortiums can be formed between specified categories, with a maximum of two bidders including the lead bidder.

requirements.quote: Bidders who have relevant experience in the following fields can submit the proposal in all categories or any one or more of the categories: Category 1: Smart Energy Meter Category 2: Head End System (HES), Meter Data Management System (MDMS) & Communication module Category 4: System Integrator
requirements.text: Bidders with relevant experience can submit proposals for specified categories.

requirements.quote: A Self-Declaration of Technology Transfer consent to be provided.
requirements.text: The bidder must provide a self-declaration of technology transfer consent.

requirements.quote: TP shall be willing to transfer the technology of offered Product/Solutions in all categories or any one or more of the categories to enable ITI to design, engineer, integrate, manufacture, Market, Sale & Service, provide maintenance of the Product/Solutions.
requirements.text: The bidder must agree to transfer technology to enable ITI to manage the product/solutions.

requirements.quote: The TP would take responsibility on behalf of ITI to obtain the required Type Approval Certificate as well as all required BIS Certificate if required.
requirements.text: The bidder must obtain required Type Approval and BIS Certificates on behalf of ITI.
